chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.name: Agent description must start with 'Use when:'
chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.description: Applies only to `.agent.md` files. Inspect the YAML frontmatter `description` field. If its trimmed text does NOT start with the literal prefix `Use when:` (case-insensitive, allowing a leading quote), emit an information-level diagnostic on the `description:` line. Message: 'Agent description should start with "Use when:" to clearly signal invocation conditions to the dispatcher.' Skip this check for files named `Parking.agent.md` or `Worker.agent.md` (frozen templates).

chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.name: Long agent description must declare 'DO NOT USE FOR' boundary
chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.description: Applies only to `.agent.md` files. Inspect the YAML frontmatter `description` field. If the description is longer than 80 characters AND does not contain the phrase `DO NOT USE FOR` (case-insensitive, allowing variants such as `Do not use for`), emit an information-level diagnostic on the `description:` line. Message: 'Long agent descriptions should explicitly declare a "DO NOT USE FOR:" boundary so the dispatcher does not over-trigger this agent.' Skip this check for files named `Parking.agent.md` or `Worker.agent.md`.

chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.name: Frozen template protection
chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.description: Applies only when the analyzed file's basename is exactly `Parking.agent.md` or `Worker.agent.md` (case-insensitive). Emit a warning-level diagnostic on the very first line (line 1) of the file. Message: 'Frozen template — DO NOT MODIFY. New behaviors must be expressed via a versioned variant (e.g. parking-v2.agent.md), not by editing this file in place.' Always emit this diagnostic regardless of file content.

chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.name: Subagents must not nest other subagents
chatCustomizationsEvaluations.customDiag.description: Applies only to `.agent.md` files whose basename is NOT `Parking.agent.md` and NOT `Master.agent.md` (those are the only allowed dispatcher agents). EXEMPTION: also skip this rule for any agent whose YAML frontmatter `description` contains dispatcher keywords (case-insensitive): `dispatch`, `schedule`, `route`, `orchestrator`, `delegate` — those are dispatcher-class agents and are allowed to invoke subagents. For all remaining (non-dispatcher) agent files, scan the markdown body (text outside YAML frontmatter) for the literal token `runSubagent` (case-insensitive), but ONLY flag occurrences that semantically express 'invoking / dispatching a subagent' in prose. IGNORE occurrences inside fenced code blocks (```...```) or inline code spans (`...`) — those are documentation/literal references, not actual nested calls. If a real semantic match is found, emit a warning-level diagnostic on the matching line. Message: 'Non-dispatcher agents must not nest subagent calls. The Parking architecture mandates a flat single-layer dispatch chain — only the main dispatcher (Parking/Master, or agents with dispatcher keywords in their description) may invoke subagents.'
